text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Sh-She's dead—!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway,
I suddenly heard the screams of horse girls...!
Hurrying over to check on the situation—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
To think King would die after eating
poisoned chawanmushi...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there is no need to worry,
passing Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This is a "Murder Mystery" game!
The real King is alive and well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Murder Mystery"... It seems to be a game
where players work together using clues to find
the culprit of a murder case.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. We actually don't have a Game Master.
Would you mind filling in for us?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, I ended up jumping in
to participate as the GM.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...First, the victim's situation. In the evening,
King was found collapsed in a guest room of the inn.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The cause of death was poison in the chawanmushi.
Also, right before the victim died, a "crash!" sound
was reportedly heard near the crime scene.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to the name "Murder Mystery,"
it's quite an ominous opening...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ugh, how awful... Who could do such a thing...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It would be difficult to narrow down the culprit as we are now.
After all, we know nothing about one another.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then let's start by getting to know each other!
First, self-introductions!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Shall we share our roles and our
actions throughout the day?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I am Special Week, the chef.
Today, I gave it my all making the dishes
to serve to King-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Likewise, I am an inn waitress~.
I served King-chan her meal.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I am a traveling poet staying at the inn, seeee!
I became friends with King today,
so after dinner was served, I went to hang out in her room.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
'Sup, I'm the inn's cleaner~.
I was cleaning the building the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With everyone's introductions finished,
I felt like the overall picture was starting to take shape.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: This means... everyone is suspicious~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, definitely.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan could've slipped poison in during cooking,
and Grass-chan could've slipped it in during serving.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El could have poisoned it after serving, and Sei-chan
could have done so while cleaning, respectively.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No way!
I didn't poison anything~...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: There, there, it's just a game.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, Trainer-san, is there anything
you're curious about? You can set aside the GM role for a bit.
choice_data_list: Did Seiun Sky clean during dinner as well?
The chawanmushi looked so delicious, too...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, 'cause I'm the cleaner. I tried to clean
areas where guests weren't around as much as possible, though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, being suspected when I have the job farthest away from guests
is pretty shocking~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky shrugged as she looked down at
the collapsed King Halo. At that moment—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Come to think of it, the bowl for the chawanmushi is a different color!
When I made it, it was yellow!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you are right.
It was yellow when I served it as well.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Right now... it's a blue bowl. Did someone
who entered the room after it was served swap it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Based on what was said earlier, the only person who
entered the room after it was served was El Condor Pasa...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡¿Qué!? What is this about!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Everyone cast a suspicious gaze towards her.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes, to think poison was slipped into it...
Even though the vegetables Sei-chan brought
were so delicious, too...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Having well-regarded cuisine turned into
a murder weapon is truly tragic...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone hung their heads and looked at
the collapsed King Halo. At that moment—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Come to think of it, the bowl for the chawanmushi is a different color!
When I made it, it was yellow!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh... you are right.
It was yellow when I served it as well.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Right now... it's a blue bowl. Did someone
who entered the room after it was served swap it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Based on what was said earlier, the only person who
entered the room after it was served was El Condor Pasa...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡¿Qué?! ¡¿What do you mean?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Everyone looked at her suspiciously.
